title: Anthropic asks Claude users to share voice data for AI model training
key_facts: Anthropic has started asking Claude users to voluntarily share voice conversations for model training.
A prompt in Claude's voice features offers 'Allow' or 'Not now'.
A separate toggle sits in Settings > Privacy.
Voice training is separate from the existing option to train on chats and coding sessions.
In the interface BleepingComputer saw, the setting is off by default.
Users can turn it off later and delete voice data from settings.
quote_evidence: Allow us to use your voice data to improve our AI models,
In the interface we've seen, the setting is disabled by default, so Anthropic isn't automatically opting users into sharing their voice recordings.
why_it_matters_hint: Opt-in voice data collection with separate control from chat training.
notes: Based on BleepingComputer's own look at the interface; Anthropic statement not quoted.
